intro: Short research-stay grant of EUR 1,300/month for 1–9 months at an Austrian university. Not a degree scholarship — PhD students, postdocs and young researchers from outside Austria are eligible.
description:
Overview

The Ernst Mach Grant worldwide is administered by OeAD, Austria’s agency for education and internationalisation, on behalf of the Austrian federal ministry. It supports young researchers from all disciplines and countries except Austria who wish to carry out a short research project at an Austrian university.

This is not a degree scholarship: you do not enrol in a full master’s or PhD programme in Austria. It funds a research stay of 1 to 9 months within the 2027/28 Austrian academic year (which begins in September 2027). Extensions are not possible.

Grant and Coverage

Ernst Mach Grant benefits and conditions
ItemDetails
Monthly grant rateEUR 1,300 per month.
Duration1 to 9 months, in whole months only (start on the first and end on the last day of a month).
Accommodation and insuranceOeAD assists with finding accommodation and arranging accident/health insurance.
Own funds requiredThe grant may not cover all costs — applicants should plan additional funds for accommodation, compulsory health insurance, travel, deposits and visa-related expenses.
Stays periodThe current call covers stays during the 2027/28 academic year, from September 2027; earlier starts are not possible.

Eligibility

  • Postgraduates pursuing a doctoral/PhD programme outside Austria; postgraduates and postdocs who completed their studies at a university outside Austria after 30 September 2025 and wish to research in Austria towards an academic career; or postdocs working as lecturers/researchers at a university outside Austria.
  • Applicants must not be older than 35 when the research stay starts.
  • All disciplines are eligible. Applicants from Austria, permanent residents of Austria, or those who completed their education mainly in Austria are not eligible.
  • A written confirmation of supervision from an Austrian university lecturer is a core requirement — you do not need to enrol as a regular student.
  • You must not have lived, studied or researched in Austria during the six months before taking up the grant.

Application Timeline

Key dates
ItemDetails
Application periodSeptember to 1 December 2026.
Deadline1 December 2026 at 23:59 CET. No documents can be submitted after the deadline.
Start of funded staysFrom September 2027 (2027/28 academic year).
SelectionApplications are evaluated by experts after the deadline.

How to Apply

  • Obtain a written supervision confirmation from an Austrian university lecturer for your research project.
  • Prepare your research plan, CV and required documents, and apply online through the OeAD scholarships portal (scholarships.at / grants.at).
  • Submit before 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET — the system runs a completeness check after you press submit, so do not leave it to the last moment.
  • Non-EU nationals planning stays over six months should allow several months for the residence-permit process and consider starting in November or December 2027.

Official Links

OeAD — Ernst Mach Grant worldwide · Application portal: scholarships.at

Important Notes

  • This is a short research stay, not a full degree — it is not suitable if you want to fund an entire master’s or PhD in Austria.
  • Age limit is 35 at the start of the stay; confirm exact wording on the official page.
  • The grant rate does not cover all living costs in Austria; own funds are required.
